title: 20Δ short strangle
description: Explore selling premium on both sides of the market.
caution: Unhedged short legs; losses can exceed collected premium.

title: 20Δ iron condor
description: Compare a strangle with protective long options.
rules: Buy wings $1,000 farther out · TP 50% / SL 100%
caution: Wing liquidity and independent leg fills matter; protection requires filled wings.

title: Bullish put credit spread
description: Test put premium selling after a nonnegative prior-hour move.
caution: The move filter can skip days; a falling market can still produce losses.

title: 15Δ wider strangle
description: Explore lower target deltas with the same exit rules.
caution: Lower delta does not guarantee smaller losses or an available fill.

title: ATM short straddle
description: Test selling the put and call at a common near-ATM strike.
rules: Sell ATM put + call · delta targets ignored
caution: Concentrated near-ATM exposure; rapid moves can trigger large losses.

title: Bearish call credit spread
description: Test call premium selling after a nonpositive prior-hour move.
caution: The move filter can skip days; a rising market can still produce losses.

title: Delta-selected wings
description: Build four custom legs using delta for both shorts and longs.
rules: Sell 0.25Δ put + call · buy 0.10Δ put + call
caution: Strike widths vary. Custom legs use the per-short reserve, not spread margin.

title: Weekend short strangle
description: Isolate weekend sessions to study a different trading schedule.
caution: Only four eligible calendar days in this sample; extend it for research.

title: Delta × stop comparison
description: Compare four variants with a chronological holdout.
caution: Three development trades is a demo threshold, not statistical evidence.
